hunks.baseline: “I heard it was important, so I took care of it as quickly as I could…… Oh my, why’s the mood so grim?”
hunks.sol: “I heard it was important, so I took care of it as quickly as I could… Oh my, why’s the mood so grim?”

hunks.baseline: The moment Hong Jin entered the room, he sensed the strange tension and asked about it. I answered with a troubled expression.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin sensed the tension as soon as he entered the room. I answered with a troubled expression.

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin glanced between Hyuk Mujin and me, then murmured, his expression suddenly growing serious.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin glanced between Hyuk Mujin and me, then murmured, his expression suddenly serious.

hunks.baseline: “It’s all right, so don’t take it too hard. These things happen sometimes. It’s part of life.”
hunks.sol: “It’s all right. Don’t take it too hard. These things happen.”

hunks.baseline: What was he talking about? Could Hong Jin know, too?
hunks.sol: Could Hong Jin know, too?

hunks.baseline: Thinking it over, he was now the East Depot eunuch, so it was entirely possible he knew about the Emperor’s illness.
hunks.sol: He was now the East Depot eunuch, so it was entirely possible he knew about the Emperor’s illness.

hunks.baseline: *Maybe he’d heard something about it while enthusiastically torturing rebels for the last three days.*
hunks.sol: *Maybe he’d heard something while enthusiastically torturing rebels for the last three days.*

hunks.baseline: Having reached a reasonable conclusion, I cautiously asked, “You already knew?”
hunks.sol: Having reached what seemed like a reasonable conclusion, I cautiously asked, “You already knew?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s supposed to be top secret…… More people know than I expected.”
hunks.sol: “It’s supposed to be top secret… More people know than I expected.”

hunks.baseline: “Eyes and ears are everywhere. No matter how tightly you try to wrap something up and keep it hidden, it’s bound to leak out eventually.”
hunks.sol: “Eyes and ears are everywhere. No matter how tightly you try to keep something under wraps, word gets out eventually.”

hunks.baseline: Some of those who’d passed through Hong Jin’s and the Embroidered Uniform Guard’s hands must have been close aides to the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord, and known the Emperor had been poisoned with Blood Soul Gu.
hunks.sol: Some of those who’d passed through the hands of Hong Jin and the Embroidered Uniform Guard must have been close aides to the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord. They might have known the Emperor had been poisoned with Blood Soul Gu.

hunks.baseline: “Uh, well……”
hunks.sol: “Uh, well…”

hunks.baseline: Maybe that was a sensitive thing to bring up.
hunks.sol: Maybe it was a sensitive subject.

hunks.baseline: I realized my mistake too late and was about to wave my hands to take it back when Hong Jin, who’d been blinking quietly, continued.
hunks.sol: I realized my mistake too late and was about to wave it off when Hong Jin, who’d been blinking quietly, continued.

hunks.baseline: “Ah. I see…… Wait. Who?”
hunks.sol: “Ah. I see… Wait. Who?”

hunks.baseline: If he was the number one target for assassination among the imperial cooks, then it had to be the Taishan I knew.
hunks.sol: If he was the imperial cooks’ number one assassination target, then it had to be the Taishan I knew.

hunks.baseline: I asked, utterly confused, “How would he know that?”
hunks.sol: Utterly confused, I asked, “How would he know about that?”

hunks.baseline: “How would he know? He saw it.”
hunks.sol: “How else? He saw it.”

hunks.baseline: “That can’t be right. He wouldn’t have seen it.”
hunks.sol: “That can’t be right. He couldn’t have seen it.”

hunks.baseline: “……What are you even talking about?”
hunks.sol: “…What are you even talking about?”

hunks.baseline: “……That’s what I’d like to ask you. What’s all this about prisoners and interrogations?”
hunks.sol: “…That’s what I’d like to ask you. What’s all this about prisoners and interrogations?”

hunks.baseline: “How…… how did you know?”
hunks.sol: “How… how did you know?”

hunks.baseline: “It’s all over……?”
hunks.sol: “It’s all over…?”

hunks.baseline: “I’m one of the last to hear, since I was away for a while. Less than two shichen after you woke up, half the people in the Inner Palace probably knew.”
hunks.sol: “I was away for a while, so I’m one of the last to hear. Less than two shichen after you woke up, half the people in the Inner Palace probably knew.”

hunks.baseline: It was like turning on the TV one day out of boredom and finding a national broadcast channel throwing a wet-dream party for me.
hunks.sol: It was like turning on the TV one day out of boredom and finding a broadcast channel throwing a wet-dream party for me.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin let out a brief yelp and dashed out. Feeling the air grow heavy, Hong Jin spoke with a troubled expression.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin let out a brief yelp and dashed out. Sensing the mood turn heavy, Hong Jin spoke with a troubled expression.

hunks.baseline: For the moment, even my worries about treating the Blood Soul Gu had been completely driven from my mind.
hunks.sol: For the moment, even my worries about treating the Blood Soul Gu had been driven from my mind.

hunks.baseline: I replied to Hong Jin’s attempt at comfort with a groan. “Don’t say that so casually when it’s someone else’s business.”
hunks.sol: I groaned at his attempt to comfort me. “Easy for you to say when it’s not happening to you.”

hunks.baseline: “Just look on the bright side. I’m actually jealous of you, Young Master Jin. Especially during the rainy season, it aches so much down there that sometimes I can barely walk without poppy……”
hunks.sol: “Just look on the bright side. I’m actually jealous of you, Young Master Jin. Especially during the rainy season, it aches so much down there that sometimes I can barely walk without poppy…”

hunks.baseline: Using his eunuch trump card—one he pulled out whenever he was bored—to shut me up, Hong Jin held out something he’d been carrying and continued.
hunks.sol: Having shut me up with the eunuch trump card he pulled out whenever he felt like it, Hong Jin held out something he’d been carrying.

hunks.baseline: “I was going to do that anyway. I’m a busy man, too. I only came to hand over the item I was asked to deliver.”
hunks.sol: “I was going to stop anyway. I’m busy, too. I only came to hand over the item I was asked to deliver.”

hunks.baseline: Realizing how badly my question had backfired snapped me to my senses. Only then did I notice the small iron chest in Hong Jin’s hand and remember why he’d come back.
hunks.sol: My badly backfired question had snapped me to my senses. Only then did I notice the small iron chest in Hong Jin’s hand and remember why he’d come back.

hunks.baseline: “This is……”
hunks.sol: “This is…”

hunks.baseline: “Obviously not. That’s what I promised you.”
hunks.sol: “Of course not. I promised you I wouldn’t.”

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin shrugged and added with a smile, “Besides, I wasn’t confident I could open it myself.”
hunks.sol: Hong Jin shrugged and added with a smile, “Besides, I wasn’t sure I could open it.”

hunks.baseline: He’d said it as if it were a joke, but the moment I took the chest from him, I realized it wasn’t entirely one.
hunks.sol: He’d said it like a joke, but the moment I took the chest from him, I realized it wasn’t entirely one.

hunks.baseline: After quickly reading through the text, I swallowed a dry laugh.
hunks.sol: I read the text quickly and swallowed a dry laugh.

hunks.baseline: *Seriously? Even if it’s only a little, why use Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron in an iron chest……?*
hunks.sol: *Seriously? Even if it’s only a little, why use Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron in an iron chest…?*

hunks.baseline: If a renowned smith used even four nyang of it to forge a weapon, people would call it a fine sword. Use any more than that, and masters with foul tempers and a knack for spitting would descend on it like starving demons.
hunks.sol: If a reasonably well-known smith used even four nyang of it to forge a weapon, people would call it a fine sword. Use any more than that, and foul-tempered masters with a habit of spitting would descend on it like A-Gwi.

hunks.baseline: And there weren’t many crazy people rich enough to mix Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into an iron chest that was nothing more than a storage box.
hunks.sol: There weren’t many people crazy and rich enough to mix Ten-Thousand-Year Cold Iron into an iron chest that was nothing more than a storage box.

hunks.baseline: Of course……
hunks.sol: Of course…

hunks.baseline: *I can think of someone right away.*
hunks.sol: *I can think of one right away.*

hunks.baseline: I gave a bitter smile and ran my hand over the iron chest.
hunks.sol: I gave a bitter smile and ran my hand over the chest.

hunks.baseline: *What could it be? What did you want to hide away so badly?*
hunks.sol: *What could it be? What did you want to hide so badly?*

hunks.baseline: “I’ll get going. There’s no point sticking around and getting in your way.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll get going. I’d only be in your way if I stayed.”

hunks.baseline: He didn’t wait for my answer before leaving the room.
hunks.sol: He didn’t wait for my answer before leaving the room. Before closing the door, he passed along one more message.

hunks.baseline: Before closing the door, he remembered to pass along one more message.
“Oh, His Highness the Emperor’s Brother and Heir asked me to tell you this.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, His Highness the Imperial Younger Brother asked me to tell you something.”

hunks.baseline: “What is it……?”
hunks.sol: “What…?”

hunks.baseline: “He misses his one and only friend. He can’t come see you right now because of the circumstances, but he wants to make sure he sees you before he leaves.”
hunks.sol: “He misses his one and only friend. He can’t come see you right now, but he wants to make sure he sees you before he leaves.”

hunks.baseline: Remembering what he’d said when he gave me the Myriad-Poison Ring at Qianqing Palace, I couldn’t help letting out a quiet laugh.
hunks.sol: Remembering what he’d said when he gave me the Myriad-Poison Ring at Qianqing Palace, I couldn’t help laughing softly.

hunks.baseline: Hong Jin answered with a slight smile of his own, then left. Once I’d confirmed that all signs of life around me had disappeared, I set the iron chest on the floor and abruptly held out my hand.
hunks.sol: Hong Jin answered with a slight smile, then left. Once I was sure no one else was nearby, I set the iron chest on the floor and held out my hand.

hunks.baseline: Along with the brief command I recited in my mind, the familiar, cold feel of metal wrapped around my hand.
hunks.sol: With the brief command recited in my mind, familiar, cold metal settled into my grip.

hunks.baseline: My personal weapon, and a divine weapon forged by the world’s greatest smith after a year of hardship.
hunks.sol: My personal weapon, a divine weapon forged by the world’s greatest smith after a year of arduous work.

hunks.baseline: And, at the same time, the key—of the physical sort—that could open that tightly locked iron chest and its five padlocks.
hunks.sol: And the key—the physical kind—to that tightly locked iron chest and its five padlocks.

hunks.baseline: With no loss of form at all, I cleanly cut through all five padlocks in a single stroke and looked inside the chest.
hunks.sol: The blade passed cleanly through all five padlocks in a single stroke. I looked inside the chest.

hunks.baseline: *This is…….*
hunks.sol: *This is…*

hunks.baseline: I’d known from the moment I first picked up the iron chest, but its contents were as spare as its weight was light.
hunks.sol: I’d known it was light from the moment I picked it up, and there wasn’t much inside.

hunks.baseline: Along with them, a bundle of papers that looked relatively recent, still white and clean, and a small silk pouch.
hunks.sol: Alongside them lay bundles of relatively recent-looking paper, still white and clean, and a small silk pouch.

hunks.baseline: For some reason, the moment I saw them, an inexplicable shiver ran down my spine.
hunks.sol: The moment I saw them, an inexplicable shiver ran down my spine.

hunks.baseline: These were the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s—or, to put it another way, his keepsakes.
hunks.sol: These were the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s—or, to put it another way, what he’d left behind.

hunks.baseline: They had to be worth more than gold and more dangerous than gunpowder, in ways that couldn’t be measured by their weight or shape alone.
hunks.sol: Surely they held something that couldn’t be measured by weight or shape alone. Something more valuable than gold and more dangerous than gunpowder.

hunks.baseline: And it didn’t take long for me to realize my instinct was right.
hunks.sol: It didn’t take long for me to realize my instinct was right.

hunks.baseline: The moment I untied the string around the bundle of papers on top, still pristine white, a bolt of lightning shot through the crown of my head.
hunks.sol: I untied the string around the still-white bundle of papers on top, and a bolt of lightning seemed to shoot through the crown of my head.

hunks.baseline: My entire body went rigid before I knew it.
hunks.sol: My entire body went rigid.

hunks.baseline: As I read the lines of text filling the page with trembling eyes, Hyuk Mujin’s voice reached my ears. I didn’t know when he’d come back.
hunks.sol: As I read the writing covering the pages, my eyes trembling, Hyuk Mujin’s voice reached me. I hadn’t heard him come back.

hunks.baseline: “Um, Captain. I don’t think I can bring him……”
hunks.sol: “Um, Captain. I don’t think I can bring him…”

hunks.baseline: His voice rang out like an echo, as if coming from far away.
hunks.sol: His voice echoed as if from far away.

hunks.baseline: Suppressing the surge of emotion, I spoke.
hunks.sol: I struggled to contain the turmoil inside me and spoke.

hunks.baseline: “……Go get them.”
hunks.sol: “…Get them.”
